decisions.decision: Bring the plug-in's FBL library from 0.1 to 0.6 first, as its own pull request
decisions.why: The mind map needs FBL 0.2 (plugin move and positioned add) and the agent activity diagram and Knowledge bindings are FBL 0.4; etalii.adp's fixtures are written for 0.6
decisions.rejected: A separate feature, or porting only what each story needs as it arrives

decisions.decision: Take the DISL interpreter from the Notion add-ons (src/disl at 4a0cdb4) and own it in the plug-in
decisions.why: 4,967 tested lines with no DOM or Notion imports, resting on a byte-for-byte copy of this plug-in's FBL library
decisions.rejected: Porting standalone's client compiler, or keeping Notion's files unedited

decisions.decision: Compute a scene in src/core/scene (Notion's scene, geometry, snapping) and give the webview one renderer for it
decisions.why: It already draws custom and composite shapes, part anchors and rulers from interpreted notation and is tested against the nine hype cycle examples
decisions.rejected: Translating notation into the webview's hand-written DiagramDefinition

decisions.decision: Make the frame contract generic: ToolType<View, Request>, a diagram and a designer differing only in what they show and ask
decisions.why: Findings, properties, toolbox, actions and outcomes are the same for a table as for a canvas
decisions.rejected: A second DesignerType contract beside DiagramType

decisions.decision: An edit is FBL splices converted to one WorkspaceEdit; FBL's own history is not used
decisions.why: Visual Studio Code's undo restores the text exactly and the editor holds the only copy
decisions.rejected: A custom editor over bytes, or two histories kept in step

decisions.decision: A claimed file of a shared extension is reopened in its tool with vscode.openWith; the designer is registered as an option
decisions.why: A manifest selects by file name only, and whether a YAML file is a Knowledge document is in its text
decisions.rejected: Default priority for every YAML and JSON file, or writing workbench.editorAssociations

decisions.decision: Definitions ship as files, are read from the install folder at start, and sync-definitions.mjs also writes the manifest's contributions
decisions.why: Removing or adding a folder is then the whole of removing or adding a tool type (FR-005, SC-005)
decisions.rejected: Bundling definitions as JSON modules imported by name

decisions.decision: The mind map's persistence plugin plans its edits here, unlike standalone's, which refuses every plan
decisions.why: Every edit in this host has to be splices of the text document
decisions.rejected: Editing the XML in place as standalone's commands do

decisions.decision: Keep two CEL evaluators: the FBL library's own and @marcbachmann/cel-js for DISL
decisions.why: DISL 12 needs macros, optionals and a function library; FBL's evaluator is the subset FBL names and is copied byte for byte into Notion
decisions.rejected: Extending the FBL evaluator, or moving FBL onto cel-js

decisions.decision: A stored position is the element top-left corner
decisions.why: DISL 11.6 gives top-left for a definition without placement.anchor
decisions.rejected: The centre, as standalone stores it; raised in etalii.adp issue 159

decisions.decision: The passes of the force layout that part overlaps run until none is left
decisions.why: The companion document 50 passes leave overlaps at 37 elements, against DISL 10.4
decisions.rejected: Stopping at 50 passes as the reference algorithm states

decisions.decision: A file of a later version opens editable with fbl.header-mismatch as a warning
decisions.why: Nothing in the binding or FBL states read-only
decisions.rejected: Read-only, as the companion document says

decisions.decision: What a view of the Knowledge designer shows is code for that one tool type, under src/core/plugins/knowledge-views and reached through the plugin registry by origin
decisions.why: DESL 7.4 names the types of a view's settings by role and not what their attributes mean, and knowledge.md gives the view logic to each host
decisions.rejected: Inferring the attributes from their types: arbitrary conventions, and no calculations

decisions.decision: DESL is read by the DISL interpreter: a .des file is given to it in its names, and operations run on its behavior
decisions.why: The metamodel, constraints, expressions and actions have the same shape

decisions.decision: Every operation is offered in a menu where its for says, and a cell is edited by the quick change of DESL 10.3
decisions.why: DESL ties no gesture to an operation by name
decisions.rejected: Gesture to operation tables in the webview, which would name the tool type

decisions.decision: Wire ids are read from a definition x- mapping found by its shape
decisions.why: The real-editor tests of the two diagrams pass untouched and ask by those ids
decisions.rejected: Keeping the specification names and rewriting those tests

decisions.decision: A pin no entry of the document holds is a corner of the registration layout, written whole
decisions.why: FBL registration module plans a place only, and an arrange and a renamed id need entries removed

decisions.decision: The tidy tree lives in src/core/scene so the canvas may preview a drag with it
decisions.why: The webview may import no interpreter code
decisions.rejected: A second copy in the webview

plan.summary: Planned six pull requests: FBL 0.6, the interpreter and the mind map, the agent activity diagram, the Knowledge designer, the two existing diagrams, the closing record
plan.key_finding: The plug-in's FBL library is FBL 0.1 and three of the five tool types need 0.2 to 0.4, so the library goes to 0.6 before any tool is connected

tasks.summary: 143 tasks in 8 phases: setup, the FBL library at 0.6, the definition foundation, one phase per user story (mind map, agent activity diagram, Knowledge designer, the two existing diagrams) and polish, one pull request each from Phase 2 on except Phases 3 and 4, which share pull request 2

approach: The plug-in reads each tool type from its copied definition: a DISL interpreter taken from the Notion add-ons and a new DESL interpreter turn a definition, its FBL binding and its plugins into one value of a generic frame contract. Edits are FBL splices applied as one edit of the text document, after the FBL library is brought from 0.1 to 0.6. Delivery is six pull requests into etalii.adp.ide.vscode.

FR-002.title: A check on every pull request and one command that refreshes the copies
